ZH: 升级您的生产房间来生产更多的资源。选中房间后，按下即可升级房间。

ZH: 您可以点击居民打开居民信息面板，给居民配备武器和装备，或者使用消辐宁和治疗针。

ZH: 您可以点击居民打开居民信息面板，给居民配备武器和装备，或者使用消辐宁和治疗针。

ZH: 选中居民即可打开居民信息面板，为居民配备武器和装备，或者使用消辐宁和治疗针。

EN: Dwellers with a high Luck SPECIAL are more successful at rushing rooms and getting CAPS bonuses when production finishes.
ZH: 运气值（L）高的居民所处的房间更容易在极速模式上成功并且在生产结束时获得更多的瓶盖奖励。

EN: Pets can give your Dwellers a boost. \nRarer Pets provide better bonus effects. \nAssign Pets like you equip Weapons and Outfits.
ZH: 宠物能给居民带来加成。\n稀有的宠物能带来更好的加成效果。\n分配宠物的方式和配备武器装备相同。

EN:
Find Junk in Lunchboxes and in the Wasteland.
Find Recipes during invasions and in the Wasteland.
Turn Junk into Weapons and Outfits in the Workshop rooms.
Upgrade your Workshops to craft Rare and Legendary items.
ZH:
在午餐盒和废土中寻找杂物。
在袭击中和废土中寻找配方。
在工坊房间中将杂物变为武器和装备。
升级工坊来打造稀有和传奇级别的物品。

EN:
- Press first on a Dweller and then on a room or the Wasteland to send the Dweller there.

- Press on a Storage Room to open your Inventory.

- On your device's home screen, press on the Fallout Shelter icon to enter a Vault directly.
ZH:
- 先点击居民，再点击房间或废土，将居民派往该处。

- 点击储藏室打开库存。

- 在设备的主屏幕上点击辐射避难所图标，直接进入避难所。

EN: Attack enemies by tapping on a Dweller and then on an enemy. You can also attack by holding your finger on a Dweller and dragging the target to an enemy.
ZH: 攻击敌人时，点击居民然后再点击敌人。您也可以按住居民不动然后拖拽至敌人处。

EN: Attack enemies by clicking on a Dweller and then on an enemy. You can also attack by clicking and holding a Dweller and dragging the target to an enemy.
ZH: 攻击敌人时，点击居民然后再点击敌人。您也可以按住居民不动然后拖拽至敌人处。

EN: To attack a specific enemy, hold [A] while a Dweller is selected to make a target appear, and then select an enemy.
ZH: 要攻击特定敌人，先选中居民，再按住使目标出现，然后选择敌人。

EN: Dwellers out in the Wasteland may stumble upon a special location! You can choose to enter this location or ignore it and continue exploring the Wasteland.
ZH: 废土上的居民可能会走到某个特殊地点。您可以选择进入这个地点或者继续探索废土。

EN: When a checkmark icon appears, select it like you would a Dweller, then hold [A] to perform a Critical Hit.
ZH: 当勾形图标出现时，选择它，然后按住来释放暴击。

EN:
- Speed up Wasteland travel time 

- Craft items instantly

- Skip more than one Objective per day

- Skip certain Quests

- Complete Barbershop customizations instantly
ZH:
- 加速废土探索时间 

- 极速打造物品

- 每天跳过不止一个目标

- 跳过特定任务

- 极速完成美发店个性化

EN:
Introducing Themes!

- Find Theme Recipe Fragments on Quests.

- Build the new Theme Workshop to craft Themes.

- Apply Themes to fully merged and upgraded Diners and Living Quarters.
ZH:
主题的介绍

- 在任务中找到主题配方的碎片。

- 建造新主题工坊来打造主题。

- 将主题应用在最大化合并及升级后的餐厅和宿舍上。

EN:
Use the Left Stick to select a room.

After selecting a room, press [A] or use the Left Stick to cycle through Dwellers in that room.

Use the Right Stick to move the camera, and [LT] and [RT] to zoom in and out.
ZH:
用左摇杆选择房间。

选择房间后，按或用左摇杆切换房间内的居民。

使用右摇杆移动镜头，和放大和缩小。

EN:
Your Vault is on top of a valuable mineral called Ultracite.

Build an Ultracite mine to collect it, then create powerful Ultracite weapons at the Ultracite Weapon Workshop.

You'll need them to defend against the Scorched!
ZH:
您的避难所建立在一种名为辐射极琉矿的珍贵矿物之上。

建造一座辐射极琉矿矿场来开采它，然后在辐射极琉矿武器工坊中打造强力的辐射极琉矿武器。

您需要它们来抵御辐尸人！

EN: Hint: High-Endurance dwellers will significantly reduce the mining timer. Don't spend your life waiting!
ZH: 提示：高耐力居民将显著减少采矿所需的计时器时间。别把时间浪费在等待上！

EN: Time to fight back against the Scorched!\n\nBuild an Ultracite Weapon Workshop to craft powerful Ultracite Weapons and defend your Vault.
ZH: 是时候反击辐尸人了！\n\n建造辐射极琉矿武器工坊，打造强力的辐射极琉矿武器，保卫您的避难所。

EN:
Scorched are on their way to attack your Vault!

Scorched are tougher and more powerful than normal invaders, but your Dwellers will be revived for free at the end of the fight.

The pain is real, but death is temporary!
ZH:
辐尸人正在前来袭击您的避难所！

辐尸人比普通掠夺者更强更难对付，但战斗结束后您的居民会免费复活。

痛苦是真实的，但死亡只是暂时的！

EN: These Scorched are tough!\n\nIt looks like help is arriving from the Wasteland. And they have a glowing green sword...?
ZH: 这些辐尸人很难对付！\n\n看起来有帮手正从废土赶来。而且他们还拿着一把发着绿光的剑……？

EN: The {RADIO STUDIO} attracts Dwellers from the Wasteland and boosts {DWELLER HAPPINESS} in the Vault.
ZH: 您的{广播室}会吸引废土上的居民，并提升避难所内的{居民幸福度}。

EN: Now that you know the basic rules of the Overseer role, keep expanding your Vault. Just remember to keep your Dwellers alive and happy. Good luck!
ZH: 现在您已经知道作为监督者的基本规则，请继续扩张您的避难所。请记住，要让您的居民活着，并且活得开心。祝您好运！

EN: Make sure you equip your {DWELLERS} before sending them out to explore the {WASTELAND}. This will increase their chance of survival.
ZH: 请确认已经给您的{居民}配好了武器装备之后再将他们送去{废土}。这将会提高他们存活的概率。

EN: No more space available for construction! {DESTROY} the {ROCK} that is blocking the room in order to proceed.
ZH: 没有足够的建造空间！请{摧毁}挡住房间的{岩石}来继续建造。
